notes: Payroll is out of scope: jurisdiction-specific and explicitly not portable. Leave and attendance are the MVP surface. The render set is a vendored Compose project — the application plus the MariaDB service the installer needs — and the application image is built from that tree's Dockerfile (php:8.3-apache-bookworm, release archive from SourceForge with its MD5 verified at build time), because upstream publishes no image. Nothing about the install is left to a browser: the entrypoint waits for the database, installs once with the values this catalog declares, and hands lib/confs, src/cache, src/log and src/config back to www-data. `lib/confs/Conf.php` is the marker, so a restart never reinstalls. Two volumes are worth backing up: orangehrm-conf (Conf.php, and the data-encryption key when enabled) and orangehrm-db (/var/lib/mysql, the schema itself). OrangeHRM Starter has no OIDC or SAML and reads no identity headers, so identity is gate-only: the edge protects the route and the product keeps its own login, which an operator provisions outside the platform. Its REST API is served under /web/index.php/api/v2/<module>; /api is not an OrangeHRM path. The silent installer stores neither a default language nor a timezone, so the product's own defaults apply until an administrator changes them in the UI — which is why those two variables are not offered.
deviation: Upstream ships a Dockerfile, no Compose file and no image at all, so the render set is vendored: docker-compose.yml with the application and a mariadb:11.4 service, plus a Dockerfile that reproduces upstream's build and adds the first-boot install. Four deliberate changes to upstream, recorded in platform/upstream/D7/README.md as well: (1) the database service is added — the installer cannot run without one, and it *refuses* a database that already exists, which is why MARIADB_DATABASE is not set; (2) upstream's `VOLUME ["/var/www/html"]` is removed, because it would shadow the installed tree with an empty anonymous volume on first run and present an uninstalled product after every restart; (3) the image is built once on the deployment host (`docker build -t orangehrm/orangehrm:5.9 platform/upstream/D7`) because there is no published image to pin — the render set pins the tag and the platform records the digest; (4) the install runs at boot instead of in a browser, through the deprecated `installer/cli_install.php`, because its replacement (`installer/console install:on-new-database`) refuses to run without a TTY.
